scope: One future world with seven independent simultaneous stations, <=5s fixed. New local instrument, not original-author CAD and not N10 F acceptance.

spring.preload_scope: Compensates platform10g only;5g dish is tared by separate same-clock empty station.

dish.colliders: Five separate finite boxes; no global convex hull across cavity.

powder.lower: Dish inner floor+3mm; correct CENTER=lower+volume/2 supplied once to original PowderCfg.

initialization: Author all platforms/dishes/knownload bodies/particle systems before one sim.reset; never post-reset teleport or outcome-selected reinitialize.

readout.equation: k/9.81 * (same-clock empty platform z - loaded platform z), averaged over final300 samples.
readout.known_load_scope: Independent validation only; rigid/PBD reference masses do not enter readout.

backend: Original Matterix CPU tensor pipeline plus PhysXGPU override1, explicitly not CPU-only rigid physics.
constraints: No solver/material/spacing/count/mass search. Default original PBD16 iterations.
Fixed5s, final1s window; no convergence-based extension.
Original instrument and frozen F criteria/results are unchanged.
declared_differences: Procedural10g60×60×6mm spring platform and5g45×35×20mm weighing dish are an explicit local instrument redesign.
Rigid collider contact offset.3mm is declared instrument geometry metadata; original PBD settings are unchanged.
